versions.content: Support for OBD Mode 0x09 (RequestVehicleInformation) 39 of 45  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 681: AUTOSAR_RS_DiagnosticExtractTemplate Requirements on Diagnostic Extract Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The diagnostic extract shall support the modeling of the OBD mode 0x09, a.k.a. RequestVehicleInformation. Rationale: The OBD mode 0x09 is a mandatory part of the OBD functionality and therefore a representation of this mode is required in the diagnostic extract. Use Case: The user wants to model the OBD service 0x09 in the diagnostic extract. Dependencies: [RS_DEXT_00076] Supporting Material: More information about this diagnostic service can be found in the respective ISO specification [7].
